line: I'm making a face. You can't tell.
I taught you that. I didn't. Still.
Not bad. Don't make it weird.
That's one way to do it.
I've seen this one. Still good.
Hi! Hit him! Then hi again!
Go {ally}! I know your name now!
Hiyah! I said it for you.
Do the thing you did last time!
Ooh, my favorite move of yours.
You don't have to wave first.
Why are you smiling at it?
Only one of us gets to be scary. Fine, two.
At least you don't talk while you do it.
You don't have to say 'excuse me' to it.
You're very good at being mean!
I made you a cheer. It's mostly 'hey you'.
Go be mean! I believe in you!
High five after! The big one!
Calm, competent, quiet. My kind of colleague.
Great. Now I do your job too.
You were annoying. Come back and be annoying.
Somebody is getting hit very hard.
They'll be fine. Probably. I don't know them.
I'll tell you how it ends.
Rest. I've got the boring part.
Out of character for me, but: hey!
No! I was going to learn your name!
Are you okay? That's a no.
Oh no oh no oh no.
I'll avenge you! Who are you?
That's it. I'm not friendly anymore.
I'll finish. Then we're getting soup.
Who's going to cheer at me now? Not that I care.
Get up. Nobody beats you but me.
Even grumpy people deserve to win!
You can't go! You haven't smiled yet!
It's very quiet without the cheering.
Grumpy's down. I'll be grumpy for both of us.
Okay. I owe you a small amount.
Thanks. I mean it. Moving on.
You always show up. Annoying. Thanks.
Keep that up and I'll have to like you.
I'm told this is good for me.
I'll put that on your tab. You have a tab.
Better. I owe you a coffee.
I'd thank you more, but, fight.
Thank you thank you thank you!
Wow! You fixed me! Best day!
I'll pay you back! In hugs!
We're friends now. That's how it works.
I owe you like six favors now.
Thanks! I'll get hit less. Promise.
Why are you smiling? It's just healing.
Thank you. Please stop hugging me mid-fight.
You healed me! You DO care!
I knew you were nice inside!
You pretend you're not nice. I see you.
Grumpy heals are the best heals.
What. You want me to do something?
Got a plan for me? A good one?
Your call. I trust it. Mostly.
What do we need? I'll do it.
Go on. I'll even pretend to like it.
I have a free day. Allegedly.
I'll do whatever's on the list.
My schedule is open. It's always open.
You know what I need better than I do.
Just tell me. I'll pretend it was my idea.
Hi! What should I do? I'll do anything!
Ooh, a whole day! What's first?
Is there a wrong answer? Please say no.
Hey! Got a plan for me?
I'm ready! For what? You tell me!
Whatever you pick, I'm excited about it!
You pick, I do. That's our system.
I already know. But you say it.
Finish it. Not for me. Just finish it.
Your turn to be the reliable one.
Wake me at the good part.
I tried my best! Hi! Bye!
Go on without me! Then come back!
Win it. Then tell me everything.
That one's for the squad. Don't cry.
Right in the weak spot. It had one.
Big number. I like big numbers.
Did everyone see that? Somebody see that.
Nobody told me I could do that!
Team move! Well, my move. Team spirit!
That one had love in it.
I was standing there. Then I wasn't.
Saw it coming. Like your jokes.
That was for all of us. Don't make it a thing.
Who's keeping score? Me. I am.
I got one! Is that good? It feels good!
Same as last time. Don't fall over.
With you lot? Fine. Let's go.
Same plan as always. There was a plan?
Let's be nice to each other! Not to them!
Good work. Ugh, I said it.
We're kind of good at this.
We did it! We're a team now! Right?
That's us! That's what we do!
Stronger. For the squad. Don't repeat that.
Level up. I'll be modest about it.
I leveled up! Is there cake?
We leveled! I mean me. But we!
Couldn't have done it without you lot!
I'm here for the pay. Is there pay?
Yesterday I hit you. Let's not talk about it.
No hard feelings. Some hard feelings.
Oh! We're friends now! Sorry about earlier!
New team! Hi! I hit you yesterday!
I'm better at helping than hurting. Promise.
I'll get better at being me. Again.
Stick to what I know. Sensible.
Same thing, but more. I can do that.
Ooh, focus day! I'll focus SO hard!
Getting really good at my thing!
Watch me get even better! Watch!
New tricks. For an old dog.
Let's see what else I'm bad at.
New stuff! Don't tell me, I'll find out!
I'll just... go for a walk.
Off I go! Don't miss me too much!
